LanguageData.BDCP.FailReason.WaitingForCutters: waiting for a plant cutter to cut {0}
LanguageData.BDCP.FailReason.NeedsCutting: {0} has to be cut by a plant cutter first
LanguageData.BDCP.FailReason.SpecialPlant: {0} has to be marked for cutting by hand
LanguageData.BDCP.Message.SpecialPlant: {0} is in the way of construction. Special plants are not marked for cutting automatically - mark it yourself if you really want it gone.
LanguageData.BDCP.Message.CuttingPrevented: {0} is in the way of construction, but cutting it is prevented. Allow cutting it and mark it for cutting if you really want it gone.
LanguageData.BDCP.Settings.Intro: Builders don't cut plants that are in the way of construction. Those plants get a cut order instead, so your plant cutters do the job.
LanguageData.BDCP.Settings.MarkOnPlacement: Mark plants for cutting as soon as a blueprint or roof area is placed
LanguageData.BDCP.Settings.MarkOnPlacement.Tip: If off, the plants are marked when a builder first tries to work on the blueprint or roof.
LanguageData.BDCP.Settings.IncludeRoofs: Also for plants that block building roofs
LanguageData.BDCP.Settings.IncludeRoofs.Tip: Trees in a build-roof area have to be cut before the roof can be built.
LanguageData.BDCP.Settings.OnlyTrees.Tip: Builders keep clearing other plants (bushes, crops, cacti, ...) themselves.
LanguageData.BDCP.Settings.ProtectSpecial.Tip: Plants like the anima tree or the Gauranlen tree are left alone and you get a message instead. Mark them for cutting yourself if you really want them gone.
LanguageData.BDCP.Settings.NoCuttersFallback: Builders cut plants themselves if nobody is assigned to plant cutting
LanguageData.BDCP.Settings.NoCuttersFallback.Tip: Counts every colonist, slave and mechanoid on the map that has plant cutting enabled in the work tab. Without anyone, construction would otherwise wait forever.
LanguageData.BDCP.Settings.SkilledBuilders: Builders with a high Plants skill cut plants themselves
LanguageData.BDCP.Settings.SkilledBuilders.Tip: Builders whose Plants skill is at least the value below cut blocking plants like in vanilla.
